name: OSS_ALLOWANCE_ALLOCATIONS
description: Following table is used to capture allowance allocations.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for usage allowance allocation.

columns.name: ALLOWANCE_GRANT_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture allowance grant id.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture used event id.

columns.name: USAGE_CHARGE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture usage charge id.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Field used to capture event quantity.

columns.name: ALLOWANCE_ROLLOVER_YN
columns.description: Field used to capture allowance rollover flag.

columns.name: BALANCE_ESTIMATE_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture balance estimate id.

columns.name: BALANCE_USAGE_CHARGE_ID
columns.description: This field tracks the the balance uage charge id.

columns.name: REVERSED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating whether the allocation has been reversed as part of rerating.

columns.name: RELATED_ALLOCATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the parent allocation which is reversed.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
